<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex013112026-07-0802-16-50" status="unreviewed">gal te rgyu ma rig pa'i bag chags cher ma song bar 'bras bu snang yul la <lb n="33b5"/> 'khrul pa cher <note type="gloss">spyir 'bras bu'i ngo °°°</note> 'gyur ba 'gal lo snyam na ma yin te | rkyen ting nge 'dzin dang zag pa med pa'i las dang smon lam gyi stobs che bar bstan pa'i phyir ro | 
            
         <note type="gloss">yang na <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">rtsang na re</rs> snang ba'i ldog pa dang rgya cher song ba'i ldog pa tha dad ste rgya cher song ldog ni ji snyed shes pa la sgrib pa'i shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs pa'i stobs kyis byung ba yin no gsungs ||</note>
            
            'on kyang sangs rgyas kyi sar ni rgyu spangs pas mi 'byung ba yin no || </seg></TEI>
